data.content:
### Northampton Town vs Tranmere Rovers (Tuesday, 7:45 pm)

Goals from Matty Warhurst and Jon Guthrie earned Northampton an excellent 2-0 win at Grimsby on Saturday, a victory that allowed the Cobblers to climb out of the relegation places. Improving Town have now lost only twice in their last seven matches in League Two and they’ve been priced as favourites to beat Tranmere at Sixfields on Tuesday. [...] Rovers are winless in six games following their 2-1 reverse at home to Barnet at the weekend and they’ve yet to register an away win in League Two this term. Tranmere did score in each of their last four assignments in the division however, and a single goal in midweek could be enough to scrape a draw against low-scoring Northampton.

Score prediction: Northampton Town 1-1 Tranmere Rovers

Back Tranmere Rovers Double Chance vs Northampton at 4/7 with LiveScore Bet [...] Grimsby’s weekend loss to Northampton (0-2) was their fourth defeat in a row in League Two, and to compound their misery, Edon Pruti picked up a serious injury in the second half, not long after Doug Tharme had to be withdrawn, too. Not much is going right for the Mariners at present and they could slip up again at Rochdale.

Score prediction: Rochdale 2-1 Grimsby Town

Timothy Rapp
Oct 19, 2026
